content:
Alice: Quick stakeholder sweep — can owners for INC-912 postmortem actions confirm assignees and due dates? Doc: https://redwood.in/pm/inc-912/rca :eyes:
Ben: I own `increase cache TTL` — ETA Fri 2025-09-05 EOD. Will open PR today. :white_check_mark:
Dinesh: I can take `canary rollback playbook` writeup. Draft by Tue morning, will need PM review from Carla.
Carla: Ack, will review Tue. Also DB migration depends on eng-infra's schema freeze — @Eva please confirm freeze date.
Eva: Schema freeze is 2025-09-03 17:00 PT. If we need a migration window after that, we have to book a special slot. :warning:
Frank: For `observability alerts tuning` I'm assigned but need SRE review on thresholds. Pinging eng-sre channel.
inc-bot: Reminder: INC-912 runbook updated at 1738251000. Actions added: cache-ttl, canary-playbook, obs-tuning, db-mig.
Ben: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infr/pull/456 — requesting review from @Dinesh.
Dinesh: Reviewing now, small nit in config, will push a fix and merge once CI passes.
Alice: Please add due dates in the shared spreadsheet and flag blockers. We'll reconcile at next Thursday's postmortem wrap.
Carla: Added dates. DB migration shows blocker `schema freeze` and is tentatively due 2025-09-07 pending freeze. :spiral_calendar:
Eva: If anyone needs an earlier window, escalate to infra and I'll try to negotiate. Ping me with the service list.
Frank: SRE asked for explicit runbook steps for throttle during rollback. Added snippet to the runbook:
```bash
# quick throttle endpoint (for on-call use)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/admin/throttle -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"pct":50}'
```
Ben: Thanks — looks good.
Dinesh: Merged PR #456 at 1738256000. Deploy to canary scheduled at 1738259000.
Alice: Great. When each action completes, please reply here with "Done" and timestamp so I can mark the tracker.
Carla: DB migration still blocked on freeze; will update once freeze passes.
Ben: Deploy completed to canary — Done (1738260500). :white_check_mark:
Frank: SRE review done, adjusted alert thresholds and closed my action (1738262000).
Dinesh: Canary rollback playbook draft shared in the doc, assigned to Carla for review — Done (draft)
incident-bot: INC-912 actions status: 3/4 complete; `db-mig` pending schema freeze. Next checklist review scheduled 2025-09-04.
Alice: Thanks everyone. Final reminder — please keep the tracker updated and escalate blockers ASAP so we can close the RCA in next week's wrap.
